title: Devastator — Capture above Tatooine
description: The Imperial-class destroyer overtakes the eleven-engine Tantive IV above the desert planet. A huge armored wedge, twin shield generators, recessed docking bay, seven aft drives and two departing TIE fighters recreate the opening chase.

sections.name: Connected wedge keel and recessed equatorial trench
Terraced dorsal city and signature command bridge
Three main drives and four auxiliary engines
Hull access plates and machinery seams
TIE patrol emerging below the destroyer
